scenes.narration: Have you noticed your hospital bills seem to be skyrocketing?
Since 1995, hospital service prices in the U.S. have surged by 385%.
In that same time, general consumer prices only grew by 124%.
Medical costs are rising at over three times the rate of everyday goods.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Why Hospital Bills Never Stop Rising

scenes.narration: Why do hospital costs keep climbing even when inflation slows down?

visual.text: Why Hospital Bills Never Stop Rising

scenes.narration: Look at the data from just the last two years.
Between January 2025 and October 2026, hospital service prices jumped 11%.
Meanwhile, overall consumer inflation was just 6% in that window.
Since 2025, hospital service costs have surged by 11%.
